CustomField.description: Required on insert even for gifts in Paid status. For outright gifts, set equal to TransactionDate. For pledge payments, match the parent GiftCommitmentSchedule row. Grant payouts: expected payout date from the schedule. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date this gift is expected. For a one-time gift being recorded now, use the same date as Transaction Date.
